fields.label: Location
fields.note: Lever categories.location. Server-side: ?location=Nowhere returned 0 rows, the bare board returned 52.

fields.label: Team
fields.note: Lever categories.team. A team query parameter was not exercised, so this field is applied locally.

fields.label: Commitment
fields.note: Lever categories.commitment. A commitment query parameter was not exercised, so this field is applied locally.

notes: meesho.io/jobs is a Next.js shell that reads the public Lever board https://api.lever.co/v0/postings/meesho?mode=json (52 postings; skip/limit paginate 15 per page) and renders detail pages at /jobs/<slug>?id=<id>. The Lever postings API applies the location filter server-side (location=Nowhere -> [], unfiltered -> 52), which is the only native facet confirmed here; the site's own search box, Team and Commitment controls filter the loaded board in the browser, so those are applied locally.
